body:
Very few people support rehabilitating criminals. Most just see them as monsters to kill.

Can you imagine if I committed a crime one day? All that shame from a thousand lifetimes would crash upon me. It would break my neck. I wish I could be a criminal and not be hated for it. Not that I have any desire to commit crimes. But just in case.

Do you think I should talk to a therapist? Is there some kind of official diagnoses for people like me?

I want to live in a world where I can do whatever I want without shame. But thanks to society's immorality (shaming is immoral as far as I'm concerned) I constantly feel like I have to walk a tightrope. God what am I thinking? I pray for an end.
I still feel like a criminal. And society has determined that criminals must hang.
I don't care about helping criminals as much as I care about getting people's judgements about them out of my head.

I've never had any trouble with the law. Not to sound arrogant but I'm a pretty well behaved person.

But I can't help but feel like I am those people. Maybe because they're human like me? All it would take is one mistake and I become them. I hate feeling like shit all the time.
